target.value: Voice AI for Revenue Cycle Teams

overview_description.description: Prosper AI develops AI-powered voice agents that automate patient and payor communications for healthcare organizations. Its platform supports tasks such as appointment scheduling, patient intake, benefits verification, billing inquiries, claim follow-ups, and prior authorization management through conversational phone interactions. The system integrates with electronic health record and practice management systems, allowing it to retrieve and update information without manual data entry. Prosper AI also includes quality assurance capabilities that review calls for accuracy, compliance, and performance, while offering analytics to monitor operations. The company serves healthcare providers, health systems, medical billing organizations, pharmaceutical companies, and other healthcare partners seeking to manage high volumes of administrative calls more efficiently.

product.description: An AI system that automates patient appointment scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellations over the phone to streamline the scheduling process.
